focus_areas: Structural validity of the 'ribbed' casing (depth vs. texture).

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the side profile of the lighter. Real lighters typically have smooth or uniformly textured casings. This image shows a distinct 'stacked' or 'ribbed' pattern. Use the geometric_depth_auditor to determine if these ribs have actual 3D depth or are just painted-on shadows (a common AI failure). Use the open_vocabulary_detector to rigorously search for the missing flint wheel and hinge; their absence supports the hypothesis that this is a malformed AI generation rather than a functional device.
image_description: A close-up shot of a metallic, rectangular object held by human fingers against a dark blue background. The object resembles a lighter but features a highly unusual, ribbed or layered side structure that looks like stacked metal plates rather than a smooth casing. A flame is visible emerging from the top right area of the object.
